text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10 code for a personal history of basal cell carcinoma is Z85.828, which indicates a personal history of other malignant neoplasms of the skin, according to ICD-10-CM data. This code is used when a patient has a documented history of basal cell carcinoma, but it is not the current active condition. For active basal cell carcinoma, a code from the C44 range (e.g., C44.111 for unspecified eyelid) should be used.

text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10 code Z86.4 indicates a personal history of psychoactive substance abuse. This code falls under the broader category of "Personal history of certain other diseases" (Z86). It specifically denotes that the individual has a past history of problems related to the use of psychoactive substances, including but not limited to, alcohol, drugs, and tobacco.

list.title: It's a personal history code:
list.snippet: This means the code is used to document a past condition, not an active substance use disorder at the time of the encounter.

list.title: Includes various substances:
list.snippet: While often associated with drug or alcohol abuse, Z86.4 can also be used for a history of tobacco use or other psychoactive substance abuse.

list.title: Not for current use:
list.snippet: This code is not for billing or reimbursement purposes when a current substance use disorder is being treated.

text_blocks.snippet: Important note: A medical professional should interpret the code in the context of the patient's medical record and overall health status, according to www.medentic.app.

text_blocks.snippet: The primary ICD-10-CM code for a family history of cancer is Z80. This code is used to indicate that an individual has a family history of malignant neoplasms (cancers).

list.snippet: Z80: is the general code for family history of malignant neoplasm.
Z80.0: is used for a family history of malignant neoplasm of digestive organs.
Z80.1: is used for a family history of malignant neoplasm of trachea, bronchus, and lung.
Z80.3: is used for a family history of malignant neoplasm of breast.
Z80.49: is used for a family history of malignant neoplasm of other genital organs.
Z80.9: is used for a family history of malignant neoplasm, unspecified.

text_blocks.snippet: When documenting, it's best to be as specific as possible. If the type of cancer in the family history is known, use the more specific code (e.g., Z80.3 for breast cancer) rather than the unspecified code (Z80.9).
